title: The community app catalog gained 762 visual previews
summary:
A garden-tending day: hundreds more app previews, restored news feeds, and a self-healing path to image GPUs.

Hundreds of retained community apps now have screenshot URLs in the catalog, with seven existing previews refreshed and a batch of covers checked in-browser before merge. Finding something interesting to build with should involve fewer mystery boxes.

The Enter news banner and website diary now fetch from explicit news-branch URLs, restoring the highlights and diary entries that disappeared after GitHub branch-path shorthand started returning 404s. The README's Latest News section was refreshed alongside it.

A watchdog now restarts Klein's cloudflared tunnel when high-availability connections stay low for 30 seconds, while preserving the existing QUIC transport and promotion safeguards. Less manual investigation of a grumpy tunnel process.
